ShortDescription.Value: Replaces the Economy panel's budget bar chart with a filterable line chart of your city's income and expense history, and optional (beta) tax offsets by building density.

Publish.LongDescription:
Fiscal Overhaul reworks the Economy panel: a line chart of your city's budget history in place of the Budget tab's bar chart, and, as an optional BETA feature, tax offsets by building density on the Taxation tab.
## Budget tab * **Line chart** of total revenue, total expenses, the monthly balance and any single budget item, each as a per-month rate (the same figure the vanilla panel shows). * **Series filters**: click a row to show or hide its line. Only the items your city has are listed. * **Time span** from 1 month to all history (1M, 3M, 6M, 1Y, 3Y, All). The history is the game's own budget statistics, already kept in your save, so a loaded city shows everything back to its founding. * **Exact values on hover**: the tooltip shows the hovered line's monthly value and how long ago it was, with the span's now / average / low / high / change under the rows. * **Vanilla detail panel**: hovering a budget item pops out the game's own breakdown by source.
## Taxation tab (BETA) This is a **beta feature, off by default**: enable it with **Enable density taxes (BETA)** in Options > Fiscal Overhaul. * An **offset per building density** under each zone, on top of the vanilla rate: residential low / medium / high, commercial low / high, office low / high, industrial. * Capped at **±5 points**, with an estimate of the extra revenue per month. * **Income only**: offsets change the tax collected, not demand or happiness.
## Options * **Enable budget chart** (default on): turned off, the Budget tab is the vanilla one. * **Enable density taxes (BETA)** (default off): turned off, every building pays the vanilla rate and the Taxation tab is vanilla; your offsets are kept. * **Reset density tax offsets**: sets every offset back to 0.
## Compatibility * Game version 1.6.x. * Replaces the vanilla Budget page and extends the Taxation group of the Economy panel: another mod that replaces either may conflict. * The mod stores **nothing in your save**: density offsets are a global mod setting, shared by all your cities. Removing the mod is safe.
## Bugs and source Bug reports and suggestions: [GitHub issues](https://github.com/DarrenGKelly/fiscal-overhaul/issues). Source code (MIT): [github.com/DarrenGKelly/fiscal-overhaul](https://github.com/DarrenGKelly/fiscal-overhaul).
Publish.ChangeLog: ## 1.0.0 First public release. * Budget tab: a filterable line chart of revenue, expenses, the monthly balance and each budget item, over 1 month to all history, with an exact-value tooltip and the vanilla detail panel. * Taxation tab (BETA, off by default; enable in Options): tax offsets per building density under each zone, capped at ±5 points, changing tax revenue only. * Options: Enable budget chart, Enable density taxes (BETA), Reset density tax offsets.
